TE QUIERO ON REPEAT – JACK HIT & OLIVIA HIT | OFFICIAL MUSIC VIDEO
One love. Two hearts. A feeling you want to play on repeat.
"Te Quiero" — I love you. And when the feeling is real, once is never enough.
Experience "Te Quiero on Repeat" by Jack Hit & Olivia Hit, a romantic music experience celebrating love, attraction, unforgettable chemistry, and the beautiful feeling of wanting someone by your side again and again.
Some songs stay in your head.
Some memories stay in your heart.
And some people make you fall in love on repeat.
Te quiero, una y otra vez.
